title: Incrementing a Binary Counter
statement: Let $m$ be a Boolean mode, $y$ a Boolean input word, $r$ one of the four work tapes, $\ell$ an access label, and $c$ a configuration of the four-tape access machine on input $y$. Suppose every work-tape head of $c$ is between $-1$ and the bit-length of $|y|+1$, and $n+1\le |y|+1$. There is a finite sequence of access-machine steps from the configuration obtained by replacing tape $r$ with the binary representation of $n$, placing its head at $0$, and setting the state to “increment on tape $r$ with label $\ell$,” to the configuration obtained by replacing that tape with the binary representation of $n+1$, placing its head at $0$, and setting the state to “read label $\ell$ in phase eC”; all other configuration data are retained.
